_comment: The harder set (v2). Asked over fixture/ PLUS fixture-v2/ (11 decoy files that share vocabulary with the v1 answers: gift cards and loyalty points next to promo codes, driver tracking next to delivery cost, address lookup next to postcode validation...). Half the questions target a decoy, half target the original file the decoy imitates - so a search that latches onto shared words gets one of each pair wrong. v1 numbers came out near the ceiling (vector-only 100% recall@5), which measures nothing; this set is meant to separate the methods.
